statements: We believe this is the beginning of something big.
We believe you're capable of more than you realise.
We believe it's completely logical to take more than one pregnancy test, just to be sure.
We believe in waiting to share the news - and in accidentally blurting it out.
We believe that, in many ways, you've been preparing for this all life.
We believe morning sickness and fatigue are actually your baby's way of saying "I'm really here!"
We believe in yelling potential baby names out the back door at dinnertime, just to test out what they sound like.
We believe in trying every possible method to predict baby's sex - even if some of them are downright ridiculous.
We believe in daydreaming about who your child will grow up to be.
We believe that pregnancy is about the best reason there is to cry for no reason.
We believe it's fun to compare your baby's size to fruits and vegetables.
We believe in the little mysteries of pregnancy.
We believe in accepting every bit of help your friends and family offer throughout your pregnancy (and beyond).
We believe in finding out the sex - or not.
We believe that no mattter what you're feeling, you're not alone.
We believe in showing off your ultrasound pic on Instagram - or telling each friend one by one.
We believe in indulging middle-of-the-night cravings.
We believe that all pregnant bodies and bumps are equally perfect.
We believe the only rule in baby naming is that you love the name.
We believe that while pregnancy is magical, it's also one of the toughest things you'll ever experience.
We believe your belly button has never been more fascinating.
We believe your voice is music to your baby's ears.
We believe in rocking your bump in a tight dress - or slouchy overalls.
We believe there's no such thing as being lazy during pregnancy.
We believe you've got this, even when you think you don't.
We believe that leggings are perfectly acceptable to wear just about anywhere.
We believe every pregnancy is different - and that's what keeps it interesting.
We believe self-care is a necessity, not a luxury.
We believe mood swings and memory lapses add variety to your life.
We believe waddling is a perfectly acceptable form of walking.
We believe in being completely full three bites after you were completely ravenous.
We believe your baby likes it when you laugh.
We believe that no matter how you give birth, that first snuggle makes it all worthwhile.
We believe in front-of-the-line bathroom privileges.
We believe naps are more of a necessity than an indulgence.
We believe in stretchy pants and lots of pillows.
We believe that unsolicited advice can be kindly and directly declined.
We believe birth is miraculous, no matter how your baby enters the world.
We believe your baby can't wait to meet you either.
We believe in love at first sight... and love that takes a while to grow.
We believe that in the postnatal phase, making it through the day is an accomplishment.
We believe that sleep deprivation is no joke.
We believe in the irresistible urge to smell your baby.
We believe that while these early days can feel isolating, talking about it makes all the difference.
We believe in throwing away a onesie after a big poonami - because sometimes it really is that bad.
We believe it's never too early to start reading bedtime stories.
We believe it's a wonderful coincidence that a feeding takes about as long as an episode of your favourite show.
We believe it's normal to discuss poo over dinner without batting an eye.
We believe you should join in on nap time just to set a good example.
We believe that spit-up matches any outfit.
We believe in not trying to pretend everything is perfect.
We believe in ordering nappies from your phone during a 2am feeding.
We believe that when you sing to your baby, your voice is perfectly in tune.
We believe sometimes your baby does things just to make you smile.
We believe a drool-covered face is as adorable as it is messy.
We believe the 4-month sleep regression is your baby's way of keeping you on your toes.
We believe that you and your baby share a secret language all of your own.
We believe your baby is really starting to appreciate all your silly voices and made-up songs.
We believe in having an unusually strong attachment to your baby monitor.
We believe that "sleep when your baby sleeps" is great advice if you can drive with your eyes closed.
We believe babies who bang on everything will someday make exceptional physics professors... or carpenters... or sound engineers.
We believe the moment you swear you can't do this is when you realise you've been doing it all along.
We believe in crossing your fingers the first time your baby tries a new food.
We believe mashed-up avocado is going to blow your baby's mind.
We believe your baby thinks you're the funniest person on the planet.
We believe "ba, ba, ba" is just the start of many conversations to come.
We believe in soft furniture, cushioned corners, and lots of cabinet locks.
We believe in backup dummies, backup loveys, backup clothes, and backup helpers.
We believe there's nothing more restorative than a hot cup of coffee or tea, even if it's been microwaved five times.
We believe your arm, your shirt, and whatever random thing your baby finds on the floor taste equally delicious.
We believe in tiptoeing around the house like a ninja after 7pm.
We believe there's no better feeling than when your baby reaches for you.
We believe those toys are as tired of being dropped as you are of picking them up.
We believe amazing things are going on inside your baby's brain.
We believe in being prepared - and in your remarkable ability to improvise when you're not.
We believe that parenting is the most rewarding - and humbling - thing you'll ever do.
We believe in soaking in the giggles, cheering at the milestones, and relishing the cuddle time.
We believe in making siren sounds every time a fire truck goes by.
We believe it's fine to skip a few pages at bedtime.
We believe that somehow even the fussiest eaters will thrive and grow.
We believe in the art of distraction and changes of scenery when crankiness sets in.
We believe that one day (although possibly in the distant future) you will be able to wee alone again.
We believe that days can be long, but the years speed by all too fast.
We believe that whatever toys you buy, there's a chance your baby will prefer the box.
We believe a lovey can be a lifelong friend.
We believe parenting is the most challenging and the most extraordinary thing you will ever do.
We believe in the journey.
